metformin_egfr30.threshold_evidence: FDA label, CONTRAINDICATIONS: 'Severe renal impairment: (eGFR below 30 mL/min/1.73 m2)'

metformin_egfr45.threshold_evidence: FDA label, DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION: 'not recommended in patients with an eGFR between 30 and less than 45 mL/min/1.73 m2' -- a NOT-RECOMMENDED-TO-INITIATE zone, weaker than the eGFR<30 contraindication; do not conflate the two families in prose

spironolactone_k5_5.threshold_evidence: rules.py's own audited status (results/threshold_provenance.md): the FDA label's potassium <=5.0 mEq/L is a heart-failure INITIATION criterion, not this contraindication ceiling. Built anyway and flagged, not hidden.

warfarin_inr4.threshold_evidence: FDA label, WARNINGS AND CAUTIONS: 'high intensity of anticoagulation (INR > 4)'
